title: No Ctrl+/ comment toggle — commenting is two buried context-menu items, and the job editor's script box has neither
existing_state: ScintillaScriptEditorControl already exposes solid CommentSelectedLines/UncommentSelectedLines methods (indent-aware, single undo action — UI/ScintillaScriptEditorControl.cs:406-443), but the only way to reach them is two separate right-click items on Form1's editor context menu with no keyboard shortcut assigned (ctxCommentSelectedLines/ctxUncommentSelectedLines, Form1.Designer.cs:885-897 — note ctxSelectAll right above them displays Ctrl+A, these display nothing). A repo-wide search confirms no Keys.Oem2/Ctrl+/ handler exists anywhere. Worse, the second editor host — JobEditorDialog's custom-preset script box — has no editor context menu at all (its only ContextMenuStrip is the hosts grid menu, JobEditorDialog.cs:68, 178, 780), so commenting there means typing '#' line by line. Toggling blocks of steps on/off while debugging a device run is one of the most frequent edits in this kind of tool.
recommendation: Handle Ctrl+/ (Keys.Oem2 with Control) inside ScintillaScriptEditorControl.Editor_KeyDown as a single smart toggle (if any selected non-blank line is uncommented, comment all; else uncomment all) — implementing it in the control gives Form1 and JobEditorDialog the shortcut simultaneously with zero per-host wiring. Merge the two menu items into one 'Toggle Comment  Ctrl+/' entry, and give JobEditorDialog the same editor context menu (or at least the toggle).
user_benefit: Comment-toggling a block of steps becomes a one-chord muscle-memory action identical to VS Code, instead of right-click + choosing the correct of two menu items — and it finally works at all in the job editor.

evidence.note: Comment/uncomment logic already exists on the control
Two context-menu items, no ShortcutKeys set
Only ContextMenuStrip in the dialog is the hosts grid menu — script editor has none
